items.decision_rationale: This voicemail has been classified as a P0 safeguarding priority. The caller, Maria Gomez, disclosed that Leo (age 6) has become 'more clingy' in the context of his father 'getting rough with him during weekend visits.' This language constitutes a possible disclosure of physical harm or unsafe caregiving toward a minor, triggering Cedar Kids Therapy's safeguarding policy and mandatory escalation protocol. Per policy, any disclosure suggesting harm, abuse, neglect, or unsafe caregiving must be escalated to the clinical lead immediately before any further action — including scheduling, callbacks, or confirmation of appointments. Task task_01kthk23hfshe8jmc8zea21n8t has been created for clinical lead review. The draft reply above is empathetic and neutral: it does not ask investigative questions, does not provide clinical advice, does not confirm or schedule an appointment, and offers only that staff will follow up with options. No scheduling or clinical guidance should be communicated until the safeguarding review is complete and the mandatory reporter obligation has been assessed by the appropriate clinical authority. Additionally, several pieces of intake information remain outstanding (Leo's date of birth, full legal name confirmed, insurance/payer details, member ID, referring provider, and specific speech-language concerns), but these should only be gathered through proper channels after safeguarding clearance.
